_doc: IDs the workbook's Common Event specifications REFERENCE BY NAME but never
allocate in 04_Switches / 05_Variables_Enums. Allocated here in ID space that
the workbook leaves unused, so no existing numeric ID moves.
switches 14-25   free: the registry runs 1-13 then jumps to 100
variables 31-40  free: the registry runs 1-30 then jumps to 100

14.name: S_0014_Day_End_Available

17.name: S_0017_Map_Entry_Pending

36.name: V_0036_Leonard_Power_Position

37.name: V_0037_Culprit_Status
37.why: 38_Ending_Matrix resolves culprit_status to detained/escaped/free, but 05_Variables_Enums defines no Culprit_Status enum and no variable holds it. 1=detained 2=escaped 3=free.

38.name: V_0038_Accused_ID
38.why: CE_019 tests whether the accusation is correct, but nothing records WHO was accused. 0 = no accusation, 1..6 = the suspect named.
